summary: iPower Inc. files an 8-K reporting an additional optional closing under an existing securities purchase agreement with an institutional investor. The company issued $3 million principal amount of Series A senior secured convertible notes at 94% of par, receiving $2.82 million in gross proceeds before fees. The notes carry a fixed conversion price of $1.03 per share, set at 120% of the prior day's closing price. A 6% cash placement agent fee is payable to Digital Offering. Proceeds are earmarked for purchasing a yield-bearing digital asset instrument. This is a routine drawdown under a previously disclosed facility, not a special situation event.
